# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_VWAP_DIVERGENCE_REVERSAL_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-06  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When SPY deviates >1 ATR below VWAP while the EMA ribbon is bullishly stacked and shows a bullish rejection candle, price tends to revert to VWAP. This captures mean-reversion momentum in intraday pullbacks within an uptrend structure, avoiding false breaks by requiring ATR-deviation and confluence with bullish ribbon alignment.

## Mechanism

Compute ATR(14). If close < VWAP - ATR and EMA8 > EMA20 > EMA50 and low <= close - 2*(close-open) (lower wick >=2*body) and close > open, then enter long at the next bar open. Exit shape: Chart-stop at the most recent swing low (structure invalidation) or premium-stop 0.5%, whichever is tighter; target 1.5R or trail 15% off HWM. Regime hint: Optimal when VIX <18 and time between 10:00-12:00; avoid VIX >25 or the first 30 minutes after open.
